author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design / character visual collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, flags, and other exhibition derivatives, plus pre-press checks. Timeline: early October first drafts, mid-October finals, early November all output files, mid-November print, early December exhibition. Seeking someone with exhibition/graphic experience and a hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: DM or comment on the Threads post.
